const fs=require('node:fs'),crypto=require('node:crypto'),assert=require('node:assert/strict');const base="migration/evidence/RN03/r2-native-recapture",i=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(base+'/capture-index.json','utf8')),p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(base+'/pixel-inspection.json','utf8'));const hash=f=>crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(f)).digest('hex');assert.equal(p.package,'RN03');assert.equal(p.revision,2);assert.equal(p.kind,'pixel_inspection');assert.equal(p.provider,'openai-codex');assert.equal(p.model,'gpt-6.1-sol');assert.equal(p.reasoningEffort,'high');assert.deepEqual(p.fallbackProviders,[]);assert.equal(p.inspectedDirectly,true);assert.equal(p.verdict,'PASS');assert(typeof p.dispatchHandle==='string'&&p.dispatchHandle.length>0);assert.equal(p.verbatimReportPath,base+'/pixel-inspection-verbatim.md');assert.equal(p.routingEvidencePath,base+'/pixel-inspection-routing.txt');assert(fs.statSync(p.verbatimReportPath).size>0&&fs.statSync(p.routingEvidencePath).size>0);assert.equal(p.images.length,i.captures.length);for(const c of i.captures){assert.equal(hash(c.image),c.imageSha256);assert.equal(hash(c.uiXml),c.uiXmlSha256);const found=p.images.filter(x=>x.path===c.image);assert.equal(found.length,1);assert.equal(found[0].sha256,c.imageSha256);assert.equal(found[0].verdict,'PASS');}for(const s of i.sourceFiles)assert.equal(hash(s.path),s.sha256,'Source changed after capture: '+s.path);console.log('Pixel report has PASS coverage/hash bindings for all eight captures; source unchanged. Runtime authenticity remains subject to independent formal reviewer inspection of saved routing/verbatim evidence; this is not package approval.');

const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path'),crypto=require('node:crypto'),assert=require('node:assert/strict');const from="tools/qwen-supervisor/.runs/2026-10-21T21-07-40-271Z-c611cd40/01-verify-software",to="migration/evidence/RN03/r2-packet"+'/prior-software';fs.mkdirSync(to,{recursive:true});const names=fs.readdirSync(from).filter(n=>/\.(receipt\.json|stdout\.log|stderr\.log)$/.test(n));const receipts=names.filter(n=>n.endsWith('.receipt.json'));assert.equal(receipts.length,10);for(const n of receipts){const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(from,n),'utf8'));assert.equal(r.exitCode,0);assert(!r.timedOut&&!r.interrupted);}const index=[];for(const n of names){const source=path.join(from,n),dest=path.join(to,n);fs.copyFileSync(source,dest,fs.constants.COPYFILE_EXCL);index.push({path:dest.replaceAll('\\','/'),source:source.replaceAll('\\','/'),sha256:crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(dest)).digest('hex')});}fs.writeFileSync("migration/evidence/RN03/r2-packet"+'/prior-software-index.json',JSON.stringify(index,null,2)+'\n',{flag:'wx'});console.log('Archived ten passing machine receipts plus their logs, byte-identical; no mutation of old run.');
